evidence: Read the current MSF-01 A page and def-statistical-experiment body. They supply one measurable sample space and a parameter-indexed family of probability laws; the domination predicate is well-typed and does not add parameter measurability.

Read the exact current definition: an experiment supplies (X,A), parameter labels Θ, and Pθ probability measures on (X,A), with no Θ sigma-algebra or parameter measurability. This supplies every input used by the domination definition.

Read the exact current definition: an experiment is an indexed family of probability measures on a fixed measurable sample space. The finite Bernoulli pair is an instance with Θ={0,1}; no parameter measurability is needed.
